verdict.rationale: The docs show that users can create API tokens from their profile page ('Create New Token') to authenticate the client. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege for an agent. Plain token creation is an adjacent capability, not scoped credentials, so the story is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
